svg.title: A retry budget inside a retry budget.
svg.desc: 4 serial retry layers; 3 total attempts per retrying layer, including the initial call. Under persistent failure, nested retries produce 81 backend attempts; one retry owner produces 3. Each tile is one cumulative attempt, not a simultaneous request or a unit of time. This timeline reveals the explanation, not production telemetry.
svg.metadata: {"type":"illustrative-model","attempts":3,"layers":4,"retries":2,"nested":[3,9,27,81],"owner":[3,3,3,3],"nestedBackend":81,"ownerBackend":3,"repeated":78,"progress":0.72,"limits":"Persistent failure; exhausted budgets; no shared deadline, cancellation, caching, circuit breaker or deduplication; not a resilience guarantee."}
svg.text: Each tile = one cumulative downstream attempt.
Spatial arrangement does not represent time or concurrency.
